roleDescs.closer: Wraps up the game once shields are gone

score.heading: Score
score.radarAria: The six parts of the team score
score.needTeam: Add three Pokémon to get a score.

threat.name: Threat cover
threat.desc: How well the team holds up against the six most dangerous counters in the league. Comes from PvPoke's threat score.

defense.name: Defensive typing
defense.desc: How many attack types the team can absorb, and how many of you are weak to the same one.

offense.name: Offensive typing
offense.desc: How many defending types your moves hit super effectively — and how many they can't touch.

bulk.name: Bulk
bulk.desc: Average Defense × HP against the league's goal. Bulkier teams can afford fewer shields.

safety.name: Safety
safety.desc: How safe the team's matchups are on average, from its switch scores.

consistency.desc: How little the movesets depend on baiting or lucky stat boosts.

elite.name: Elite
elite.summary: A tournament-grade core. Few real weaknesses and a plan for almost everything.

strong.name: Strong
strong.summary: A very solid team. A couple of gaps to keep in mind, but it can climb.

solid.name: Solid
solid.summary: Works well on paper. Look at the warnings below to tighten it up.

shaky.name: Shaky
shaky.summary: Real holes in coverage or bulk. Small swaps could make a big difference.

risky.name: Risky
risky.summary: This team will struggle against much of the league. Try the suggestions below.

threat.heading: Threats and coverage
threat.needFull: Add three Pokémon to see the threat score.
threat.lowerBetter: A lower threat score is better.
threat.partOfScore: It is also the heaviest part of the Team Score ({{pct}}%): the lower the threat score, the higher the Team Score.
threat.gridAria: How hard each threat beats each of your Pokémon
threat.help: It measures how vulnerable your team is to specific Pokémon — the lower, the better. It looks at how many of your Pokémon a threat can beat, how hard it beats them, how highly ranked it is (how likely you are to meet it) and how consistently it performs. Numbers in the grid are the threat's own battle rating against each of your Pokémon, averaged over 0 and 1 shields: above 500 means it wins.

grades.A: Excellent coverage. The league's best counters have a hard time with this team.
grades.B: Good coverage. A few threats are worth watching for.
grades.C: Some gaps. A handful of Pokémon can push this team around.
grades.D: Highly vulnerable to certain threats. Look for picks that handle them.
grades.F: Very poor coverage against several top threats.

coverage.summary: {{covered}} of the top {{total}} Pokémon are beaten by someone on your team, {{secure}} of them decisively.
coverage.holesHint: These top-ranked Pokémon have no good answer on your team. Consider a pick that handles some of them.
coverage.noHoles: Every top Pokémon has an answer on this team.

typing.heading: Typing
typing.resisted: types resisted by at least one Pokémon
typing.critical: Two or more of you are weak to these and nobody resists them:
typing.noSharedWeakness: No weakness is shared by two Pokémon.
typing.blindSpots: Nothing hits these for even neutral damage:
typing.noBlindSpots: Every type is hit for at least neutral damage.
typing.defenseAria: Damage each type deals to each of your Pokémon
typing.offenseAria: Best damage your moves deal to each type

status.critical: Two or more weak, none resist

stats.heading: Numbers
stats.ivNote: Every Pokémon is built with its best possible IVs (rank 1 stat product) for this league, so scores show a team at its ceiling. PvPoke rates with its own default IVs, so its numbers can differ slightly.

coverage.name: Coverage
coverage.A: This team has excellent coverage against top meta threats. It has few or no major vulnerabilities.
coverage.B: This team covers most top meta threats. There may be a few vulnerabilities to look out for.
coverage.C: This team has coverage gaps and may be vulnerable to certain threats. Consider alternative picks or movesets to shore up your weaknesses.
coverage.D: This team is highly vulnerable to certain threats. Consider alternative picks to avoid doubling up on weaknesses, or look for Pokémon that perform well against the top meta.
coverage.F: This team has extremely poor coverage against multiple threats. Consider strong meta alternatives to anchor this team.

bulk.A: Excellent average bulk. It will help manage shields and overcome tough scenarios.
bulk.B: Good average bulk. Save shields for your more fragile teammates.
bulk.C: Moderate bulk. You may be pressured to shield more often.
bulk.D: Low bulk. You'll be pressured to shield often. Consider bulkier picks.
bulk.F: Extremely fragile. It will be hard to recover from bad situations.

safety.A: Extremely safe matchups. Flexible and easy to pivot to regain advantage.
safety.B: Mostly safe matchups. It can work back from a lost lead.
safety.C: Only somewhat safe. Limited safe switches — be ready to spend shields.
safety.D: Generally unsafe. It relies on winning the lead and keeping switch advantage.
safety.F: Very unsafe. It relies heavily on winning the lead and lining up perfect counters.

consistency.A: Extremely consistent movesets. Dependable damage output.
consistency.B: Mostly consistent. It won't depend on baits often.
consistency.C: Mixed consistency. You might depend on baits now and then.
consistency.D: Low consistency. You'll depend on baits or stat boosts often.
consistency.F: Poor consistency. You'll be highly dependent on landing baits or boosts.

warnings.heading: Watch out for
warnings.none: Nothing to flag. This team has no glaring overlaps or holes.
warnings.criticalWeakness: {{names}} are all weak to this type and nobody on the team resists it.
warnings.sharedWeakness: {{names}} share a weakness to this type.
warnings.sharedTyping: {{names}} share this type, which stacks their weaknesses.
warnings.blindSpot: Your moves can't hit these types for even neutral damage.
warnings.fragile: {{name}} is fragile for this league and will lean on shields.
warnings.baitDependent: {{name}} depends on baiting or stat boosts to do its damage.
warnings.noLead: Nobody here is a strong lead.
warnings.noSafeSwitch: Nobody here is a really safe switch.

suggest.heading: Upgrades
suggest.higherBetter: A higher team score is better.
suggest.searching: Trying out top Pokémon in every slot…
suggest.failed: Couldn't compute suggestions. Try again in a moment.

top.intro: The highest-scoring teams we found: every trio of the {{candidates}} best Pokémon of the league, each with its recommended moves and top IVs, rated like the builder does. Tap one to open it in the builder.
top.note: Rated {{date}} from {{total}} possible teams. Order within each team: lead, switch, closer.
top.empty: No team ranking is available right now. Check back soon.
top.noMatch: No team in the ranking includes that Pokémon.

help.teamScore: The overall rating, 0–100, higher is better. A weighted blend of six parts: threat cover {{threat}}%, defensive typing {{defense}}%, offensive typing {{offense}}%, bulk {{bulk}}%, safety {{safety}}% and consistency {{consistency}}%.
help.threat: PvPoke's measure of how vulnerable the team is to the league's six most dangerous counters, from simulated battles with 0 and 1 shields. Lower is better.
help.order: The arrows show the order to play them: lead, then the safe switch, then the closer. We pick the order that adds up to the highest role scores.

collection.intro: This collection is saved in this browser and kept separate for each league. Add Pokémon, adjust moves, level and IVs, then confirm to save.
collection.duplicate: You already have this exact Pokémon saved (same moves, IVs and level).
collection.needThree: Save at least three different Pokémon in this league to build teams.
collection.manualNotice: With more than 10 Pokémon, calculating every team can take a while. Results are temporary and won't be saved with your collection; league rankings or simulator updates may change them later.
collection.noCombinations: No valid three-Pokémon teams can be formed from this collection.

favorites.empty: No favorite teams in this league yet. Tap the star on a team to save it here.
favorites.unratedNotice: With more than {{limit}} favorite teams in a league, they are not rated automatically (every rating is a battle simulation), so the cards show no scores. Open a team in the builder to see its rating.
